about: Invented data for the daytrip branch (TG-PHASE-15 WP-15a): an invented base (Bramblecombe) and invented towns, payloads every validator must accept or refuse alike, and the trip they belong to. valid[0] is also the pinned payloads test's daytrip example (fixtureValid in tests/pack_tour-guide_payloads.test.js).
